result.one_liner: Zoho CRM is a cloud-based customer relationship management platform offering sales automation, contact management, and business intelligence features.

evidence.quote: REST API endpoints support OAuth 2.0 and API key authentication, which can be enabled or disabled independently.
Zoho offers a fully featured free Developer Edition that is the perfect environment for users to learn their way around Zoho CRM
Zoho CRM offers flexible RESTful endpoints and GraphQL API endpoints allowing you to perform CRUD operations
GraphQL APIs are available in Enterprise, Zoho One Enterprise, CRM Plus and Ultimate edition. GraphQL currently supports only query operations.

result.notes: Zoho CRM has self-serve free Developer Edition and free CRM tier for testing. OAuth2 is primary auth method with API key also supported. REST API broadly available; GraphQL is read-only and limited to higher-tier editions. API breadth estimated at medium based on typical CRM endpoint count.
